title_zh: 缩小对部长的采访问题并保留不同意见

scenario.label_zh: 明确虚构公共项目采访问题的范围
scenario.goal_zh: 依据给定公告拟定关于车辆用途的具体问题，并限定来信统计的适用范围

context_zh: 校报编辑萨米与记者爱丽丝讨论一份完全虚构的公共救援项目公告；不涉及现实政治人物或选民。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: The minister has agreed to answer one question about the new emergency centre. What should we ask?

sentences.speaker: Sami
sentences.text: The announcement mentions military vehicles. I'd ask what role those vehicles will have and who will manage them.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: We've received numerous letters about that. A majority support the project, so can I say the town supports it?

sentences.speaker: Sami
sentences.text: No. A majority of our letters isn't the same as a majority of residents.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: And a minority of the writers want more information about noise and traffic.

sentences.speaker: Sami
sentences.text: Those concerns belong in the introduction too. We don't know how representative either group is.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.text: I'll state the numbers as letters received, then ask about the vehicles' purpose and management.

sentences.speaker: Sami
sentences.text: That's a clear question. Keep any claim about the whole town out of the draft.
